en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European spa or resort town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a prominent villa-style building with half‑timbered decorative gable and the name "Villa Zipfel" painted on the facade; a woman is visible near the entrance and a fenced garden surrounds the house. Other detached villas and small houses line a curving road leading into the town, with wooded hills and fields in the background.
